notes.title: FREE HD 4K Remaster update is live!
notes.notes:
Hello puzzle solvers,

The Mad Experiments series is a bit more than 5 years old and the games are still quite popular, so I figured out it was time to give tons of love to [b]Mad Experiments 1 and 2.[/b] We upgraded visuals, controls, and added tons of small quality-of-life improvements!

Here's the list of what changed:
[list]
[*] All the textures of the game are now in 4K
[*] Re-vamped controls with keyboard + mouse
[*] Improved gameplay and removed motion sickness
[*] Improved clue system in Mad Experiments 1
[*] Fix many glitches and viausl artefacts in all rooms
[*] Co-op games should now be more stable
[/list]

Thank you for your continued support!
Report issues via Steam Discussions or our support portal.

Join our Discord or drop a message in Steam's forums if you want to have a chat with us! :)

notes.title: Community patch
notes.notes:
Hello there,

We fixed an issue where players would get stuck because of objects on the floor, so we increased the height of the "step" the player can take. We could not get stuck when we played afterwards so hopefully you neither! :)

Thank you for your feedback!

Stay sharp,
Clem

notes.title: v2.0 - 100% Controller Support, Quality-of-life improvements and bug fixes!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

I wanted to update Mad Experiments 1 one last time, with some things that were left behind because of lack of when the game launched.

Here's the list of addition:
- The game can now be played with a remote controller from launch to finish, menus included
- Players can now jump and sprint!
- You can now skip the cinematics
- A lot of little bugs fixed in Room 1, 2 and 3
- The in-game UI has been slightly improved, along with interactions with objects

notes.title: Major Update to celebrate the release of Mad Experiments 2!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

The long-awaited Mad Experiments 2 is now released and we wanted to include in Mad Experiments 1, the improvements and new features we added on the sequel.

While these additions will mostly benefit to the new players, old players would be pleased to know that their feedbacks have been heard!

So here's a batch of new things added to the game:
- Better UI and menu navigation
- A lot of optimizations have been done to the textures, models, and every rooms. The game is now lighter and will work better on low/middle end computers.
- Free masks!

Thank you so much for your support throughout the years!


Stay sharp, have fun!
Clem

notes.title: v1.58: Japanese translation and bugfixes! マッド・エクスペリメンツ：エスケープ・ルームへようこそ！
notes.notes:
As usual, [b]first of all I want to thank you for your reviews on Steam and comments on Discord. Your feedback has been amazing[/b], you (really) liked Chapter 1, now I want to blow your mind with Chapter 2.
I'm currently working on more secrets, harder puzzles, and polishing the mind-bending atmosphere I want you to experience.

[h2]MEER now available in Japanese![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36264782/1a3d7a3fde114b37ca5173b0710e6ebae99199ec.png[/img]

For the Japanese speakers out there, that would be awesome if you could try this update and tell me what you think about the translation. It's very important that the clues are giving the right information in every language, or it could ruin your experience.

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/5zqEF4JIasr844KWDF/giphy.gif[/img]

[b]The translator and I have been very careful to respect every aspect of the game so I hope the result will suit your expectations![/b]

Other languages will be added in the coming weeks: German, Spanish, Brazilian Portuguese, Russian, Traditional Chinese, and Korean!

[h3]Patch Notes 1.58:[/h3] [list] [*] The entire game and menus have been translated into Japanese
[*] It's no longer possible to drop items while crouching
[*] Fixed Pause menu UI not displaying properly for some people
[*] Fixed RELAX MODE text helper position
[*] Network bugfix: Changing mask now works if you join after a player changed its own mask
[*] Reduce size: Remade every clue textures + added compression
[*] Fixed a typo in French translation
[*] Fixed some typo
[*] Various under-the-hood improvements related to Chapter 2
[*] Updated Networking framework
[/list]

Thank you again for your tremendous support!

Stay sharp!

Clem

notes.title: v1.54 Update with "Extra Clues" menu is here!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

I listen to your feedback very carefully as I want to game to feel comfortable when you play. That's why a new section in the Player's Menu is born: "More Clues"! It's the first version so keep in mind that the visual is not final.

[h3]Patch Notes 1.54:[/h3] [list]
[*] [b]Extra clues: Added the first version of the "Extra Clues" section in the player's pause menu.[/b] Based on your feedback, the game now provides additional clues for players who don't want to get out of the game to get more clues.
[*] [b]New Achievement - Master Mind:[/b] FInish the room without using extra clues
[*] [b]MacOS & Linux "mouse not centered" issue: FIXED! Thank you for your patience! <3[/b]
[*] Lobby room: Table collisions fixed!
[*] Comfort UI: "Use" only appears if target at an interactable object
[*] Timer has been 100% reworked so now, [b]if the host disconnect, the timer will stay synced[/b].
[*] FOX bugfix: Zooming-in will not reset camera's FOV anymore
[*] [b]Updated text on Crystal to help people in phase 2[/b]
[*] Fixed typo on Generator when complete
[*] Maze: Fixed maze missing walls + improved lighting
[*] Fixed some minor issues on player UI
[*] macOS: Fixed some UI text not showing on Mac
[/list]

Thank you for your tremendous support!

Stay sharp!

Clem

notes.title: v1.50 Update with RELAX MODE is here!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

[b]RELAX MODE is here![/b] This feature was requested by many of you, it's happening!

In this mode, there is [b]no time limit![/b] You can now chill and take your time to escape the room because time has stopped...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36264782/6d8951911b0256944b2c01a49d4f495df201462f.png[/img]

Patch Notes 1.50:
[list]
[*] RELAX MODE IS HERE! Chill and relax, you now have unlimited time in the room :) Just activate it when you create your game!
[*] Room 1: Some minor visual improvements
[*] Settings: Added resolutions 1680x1050 and 5760x1080
[*] Settings: Master Volume is now called Ambient Volume ;)
[*] Increased the time before you get kicked from the maze for not moving
[*] Various network improvements
[*] [b]macOS UI[/b]: The text should now appear correctly in Player's pause menu
[/list]

I'm still working on the "mouse-not-centered" issue on macOS and Linux, as well as a rare issue that could happen when 2 players try to pick-up simultaneously the same item. Both should be fixed next week.

Thank you for your tremendous support!

Stay sharp!

Clem

notes.title: Update 1.42 for PC / MacOS / Linux
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,
The large majority of you are having a smooth ride but on some specific occasions, few bugs appeared.

[b][h2]Patch notes 1.42:[/h2][/b]
[b]- MacOS: Trackpad and mac mouses should now work as intended[/b]
- Comfort: Increase brightness on some clues
- French: Fixed typo
- Gramophone: fixed wrong text showing when adding the handle
- Fixed message in the feedback report
- Added possibility to pass the early access message with any key
- Updated some localization texts



[h3][b]Know Issues on macOS & Linux[/b][/h3]
The cursor could be off-centered, which makes picking up objects and interacting a pain.
[b]For now, there is a workaround[/b]: In the visual settings, try to change the game's resolution or screen aspect (full screen seems to be the most stable).
It's a complicated issue as the bugs come from the 3D engine that I use. I tried to write specific code for this issue for both Mac and Linux but I didn't succeed to fix it yet. [b]I will definitely keep you updated![/b]


Thank you for your support and your patience!

Stay safe and sharp!

notes.title: Update 1.41 for PC / MacOS / Linux
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

Here are the first patch notes for [b]v1.41[/b]. The large majority of you are having a smooth ride but on some specific occasions, few bugs appeared.

[b][h2]Patch notes 1.41:[/h2][/b]
- Updated Unity Engine to 2019.3.10f1

- [b]Bug[/b]: Fixed a rare issue that could occur if multiple clients disconnect during the end scene
- [b]Bug [/b]stuck: Fixed collision to avoid getting stuck in the generator room

- [b]UI[/b]: Fixed some UI issue on EndScreen

- [b]Networking[/b]: Fixed errors if a client disconnects from the game then reconnects
- [b]Networking[/b]: Improved how some puzzles are handled in multiplayer
- [b]Networking[/b]: Optimizations on the Player


[h3][b]Know Issues on macOS & Linux[/b][/h3]
The cursor could be off-centered, which makes picking up objects and interacting a pain.
[b]For now, there is a workaround[/b]: In the visual settings, try to change the game's resolution or screen aspect (full screen seems to be the most stable).
It's a complicated issue as the bugs come from the 3D engine that I use. I tried to write specific code for this issue for both Mac and Linux but I didn't succeed to fix it yet. [b]I will definitely keep you updated![/b]


Thank you for your support and your patience!

Stay safe and sharp!

notes.title: Release of the game in April 2020 - Follow and Wishlist to get notified!
notes.notes:
[h1][b] Release in April 2020![/b][/h1]
The game will release with an additional 1-hour room in April 2020! Don't forget to wishlist and follow to support the game and get notified when it's released!

I intensively patched the game in December and January to make it stable and more user-friendly. The visual quality has improved along with performance, puzzles and clues have been refined.
[b]TLDR: The game is in a very good state, now it's time to make Room 2![/b]


[h1][b]What a crazy beta![/b][/h1]
I never imagined receiving such warm and passionate support about players.
During the last 90 days, thousands tried the game, and hundreds gave me feedback and reported bugs. THANK YOU!

[b]Join us on our Discord for the latest news, giveaways, community events and surprises to come :)[/b]
